sn17.10:1.3: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ passāmi lābhasakkārena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinnacittaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannaṃ.
sn17.10:1.4: idha panāhaṃ bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ passāmi asakkārena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinnacittaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannaṃ.
sn17.10:1.5: idha panāhaṃ bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ passāmi sakkārena ca asakkārena ca dvayena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinnacittaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannaṃ.
sn17.10:1.6: evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya. tasmātiha bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ: ‘uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ
sn17.10:1.7: pajahissāma. na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī’ti. evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
sn17.10:2.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
